senses.sense_definition: The punctuation mark ⟨,⟩ used to separate parts of a sentence or elements in a list.

examples.text: You should place a <w>comma</w> after the introductory phrase in this sentence.

target_lang_translations.zh: 你应该在这句话的引导短语后加一个<w>逗号</w>。

examples.text: The list includes apples, oranges, and <w>commas</w> are not needed before the final item.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这份清单包括苹果和橘子，最后一项前不需要<w>逗号</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 用于分隔句子成分或列表项的标点符号（，）。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指书面语中的标点符号

senses.sense_definition: A type of butterfly with a small, comma-shaped mark on its wings.

examples.text: The <w>comma</w> butterfly is often found in woodland areas during the summer months.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>钩蛱蝶</w>常在夏季出现在林区。

examples.text: We spotted a rare <w>comma</w> resting on a leaf in the garden.

target_lang_translations.zh: 我们在花园里发现了一只罕见的<w>钩蛱蝶</w>停在叶子上。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种翅膀上有逗号状斑纹的蝴蝶。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指一种带有逗号状斑纹的蝴蝶

senses.sense_definition: A small mark placed below a letter to change its pronunciation or meaning.

examples.text: The letter is written with a <w>comma</w> underneath to indicate a specific sound.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这个字母下方写有一个<w>下逗号</w>以表示特定的发音。

examples.text: Some languages use a <w>comma</w> as a diacritic mark in their writing system.

target_lang_translations.zh: 有些语言在书写系统中将<w>下逗号</w>用作变音符号。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 置于字母下方以改变其发音或意义的附加符号。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指作为变音符号使用的逗号

senses.sense_definition: A very short period of time or a brief pause.

examples.text: He waited for a <w>comma</w> in the conversation before speaking his mind.

target_lang_translations.zh: 他等谈话出现了一个<w>停顿</w>才说出自己的想法。

examples.text: The music stopped for a brief <w>comma</w> before the final movement began.

target_lang_translations.zh: 音乐在最后一个乐章开始前有了一个短暂的<w>停顿</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 极短的时间或短暂的停顿。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指对话或音乐中的短暂间歇

senses.sense_definition: A tiny difference in pitch between two musical notes that are theoretically the same.

examples.text: The tuner adjusted the strings to account for the Pythagorean <w>comma</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 调音师调整了琴弦以修正毕达哥拉斯<w>音差</w>。

examples.text: Musicians must understand the <w>comma</w> when tuning instruments for perfect harmony.

target_lang_translations.zh: 音乐家在为乐器调音以达到完美和声时，必须理解<w>音差</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 理论上相同但音高有微小差异的两个音符之间的音程。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指音乐理论中微小的音高差异

senses.sense_definition: A symbol used to separate different parts of a genetic sequence.

examples.text: The researchers inserted a <w>comma</w> to mark the boundary between the two gene segments.

target_lang_translations.zh: 研究人员插入了一个<w>分隔符</w>来标记两个基因片段之间的边界。

examples.text: The genetic code is easier to read when a <w>comma</w> separates the sequences.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当用<w>分隔符</w>将序列分开时，遗传密码更容易阅读。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 用于分隔基因序列不同部分的符号。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指遗传学中用于标记序列边界的符号

senses.sense_definition: A short phrase or clause in classical rhetoric.

examples.text: The orator used a rhythmic <w>comma</w> to emphasize his point during the speech.

target_lang_translations.zh: 演讲者在演说中运用了有节奏的<w>短句</w>来强调他的观点。

examples.text: In ancient texts, a <w>comma</w> was defined by its limited number of syllables.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在古代文献中，<w>短句</w>的定义取决于其音节的数量。

traits.comment: Used in the context of classical rhetoric.

target_lang_definitions.zh: 古典修辞学中的短语或从句。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指修辞学中结构简短的成分

senses.sense_definition: To insert a comma into a piece of writing.

examples.text: Please remember to <w>comma</w> the list correctly before submitting your essay.

target_lang_translations.zh: 请在提交论文前记得正确地为列表<w>加逗号</w>。

examples.text: The editor had to <w>comma</w> the long sentence to make it easier to read.

target_lang_translations.zh: 编辑不得不为这个长句<w>加逗号</w>，使其更易于阅读。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指在写作中插入标点符号的动作
